templates.source: https://vikylin.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/YCX-Series-IP-Camera-Instructions.pdf — Vikylin YC Series Quick Start Guide, FAQ 5.4 'How to fetch the RTSP video stream and http snapshot?': 'Main Stream: rtsp://admin:123456@IP address/stream0'. Identical text in the PG Series guide (https://vikylin.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/PG-Series-IP-Camera-Instructions.pdf, FAQ 5.4).

https://vikylin.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/YCX-Series-IP-Camera-Instructions.pdf — Vikylin YC Series Quick Start Guide, FAQ 5.4: 'Sub Stream: rtsp://admin:123456@IP address/stream1'. Identical text in the PG Series guide (https://vikylin.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/PG-Series-IP-Camera-Instructions.pdf, FAQ 5.4).

notes: Vikylin sells several OEM lines with different firmware, so the RTSP path depends on the series. This guide is the path Vikylin's own manuals print for the PG and YC series (AjDevTools / Videolink firmware): /stream0 (main) and /stream1 (sub). The manuals print the URL without a port, i.e. the RTSP default 554; the example credentials are admin / 123456. Other lines documented by Vikylin: VK series (Hikvision-OEM) — the VK Series guide gives /h264/ch1/main/av_stream and /h265/ch1/sub/av_stream, and Vikylin's stream-access article (https://vikylin.com/nvr-and-ipc-stream-access/) gives /Streaming/Channels/101 (main) and /Streaming/Channels/102 (sub); VD series — the VD Series guide states these are OEM models customized from Dahua and refers to Dahua's guidance, i.e. /cam/realmonitor?channel=1&subtype=0 (main) and subtype=1 (sub); PG-N series (Remoteyes / SettingTool firmware) — the PG-N quick start guide gives /media/live/1/1 (main) and /media/live/1/2 (sub) on port 554. Cameras of the lines that differ carry their own URL on the camera record. No Vikylin document states an RTSP path for the PTZ-* models; confirm their path via ONVIF or the camera web UI.
